lead: What Saugerties homeowners can really get in 2026, checked against Central Hudson and NYSERDA on October 3, 2026.
cards_heading: What you can claim in Saugerties in 2026
cards_intro:
Short answer: In Saugerties, the main heat pump rebate is NYS Clean Heat (run by Central Hudson): up to $12,000 (Weatherized Tier, old system removed) for a whole-home system, taken off your contractor’s bill. It is one rebate, not several that add up. Lower-income households can get much more through EmPower+, and the federal tax credits ended on December 31, 2025.

after_cards: These are single-family amounts. Apartments and homes under 1,000 sq ft get about half ($2,000 / $3,500 / $1,000, or $4,000 / $6,000 in the Weatherized Tier). Central Hudson’s table does not list a separate DAC column, and its cap is 85% of cost.
sections:
Saugerties is a rural Ulster County town served by Central Hudson for electricity. Many homes have no gas line and heat with oil or propane, which are the most expensive fuels to keep; that makes a whole-home heat pump with the old system removed the best-paying option here.

Many Saugerties homes are on wells and septic and far from gas lines, and some are seasonal or older farmhouses. A home that is only lived in part of the year should still be sized for the whole house, since that is what Clean Heat pays for.

Long electrical runs and older panels are common in rural homes, so ask your contractor to check your service size early.

Clean Heat is the Central Hudson rebate, so never add the two together. Clean Heat is capped at 70% of cost (85% in a DAC). There is no separate federal HEAR cheque: New York delivers it through EmPower+. The federal 25C/25D tax credits ended December 31, 2025.

Income-qualified? EmPower+ can cover far more than the utility rebate. Check the state DAC map too: it can raise your amount.
claim_heading: What to do next in Saugerties
claim_steps: Have an electrician check your panel and service size first.
If you heat with oil or propane, get a quote that removes the old system.
Get 2–3 quotes and ask each contractor to show the rebate tier on the quote.
faq: How much is the heat pump rebate in Saugerties?

NYS Clean Heat (run by Central Hudson) pays up to $12,000 (Weatherized Tier, old system removed) for a whole-home heat pump in Saugerties, depending on home size, whether you remove the old system, and DAC status.
Can I get the Central Hudson rebate on a rural Saugerties home with no gas?
Yes. Oil and propane homes qualify, and removing that old system earns Central Hudson's higher $7,000 tier for a single-family home ($12,000 in the Weatherized Tier).
Is the federal tax credit still available for heat pumps?
No. The federal 25C and 25D credits ended for anything installed after December 31, 2025.

Lower-income owners and renters of 1-4 family homes. Low-income households can get free upgrades up to $12,000 upstate or $14,000 downstate; moderate-income households get 50% covered up to $6,000 upstate or $7,000 downstate.
